newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sells 15 pct Isla Bonita to Spain's Once.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sells 15 pct Isla Bonita to Spain's Once.

text.p: Venezuela's state Deposits Guarantee Fund, Fogade, said Tuesday it had sold a 14.99 percent stake in the Isla Bonita luxury tourist complex to Spain's Organizacion Nacional de Ciegos de Espana (Once) for 850 million bolivars ($1.8 million).
Once was the only bidder for the five-star complex on Margarita Island, just off Venezuela's Caribbean coast.
Fogade inherited a stake in the hotel complex after the take- over of local investment bank Fivenez in June 1994.
The remaining 85 percent of Isla Bonita is owned by International Tourist Fund AVV, a subsidiary of Once based in Aruba.
